text:
Alex: Heads-up — product reported several large customers burning budget on xlarge-family models. They want model-aware quotas + clear console visibility for burst usage. Can we sketch enforcement and UX for burst caps and soft fallbacks?
Riley: What are the concrete goals? hard cap per API key vs per-org? burst windows length? :thinking:
Sam: From infra: propose per-api-key steady-rate + per-family burst window. Example: steady 1 rps equiv (60 req/min) + burst 300 requests over 5m for xlarge. Fallback routing to smaller family when burst is exhausted.
Maria: For console UX: show a "Projected throttle" timeline and per-model-family usage breakdown. Also show which requests would have triggered fallback in last 24h, actionable for SREs/PMs. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
Alex: Draft policy object for enforcement (runtime reads this):
```
model_family: xlarge
steady_rps_per_key: 1
burst_capacity_tokens: 500
burst_window_secs: 300
fallback_priority: [large, medium]
count_cached_tokens: false
```
Riley: Two questions: 1) Count cached prefix tokens against quota? 2) How surface reasons to callers — header vs body?
Sam: 1) Prefer NOT counting cached prefix tokens — they rarely incur compute. 2) Add X-Quota-Status header + structured 429: {code: "quota_exhausted.family_xlarge", fallback_to: "large"}. Also include remaining_burst_tokens in header.
Maria: Console should map header codes to human text, show sample throttled requests, and add a rollout toggle: "soft mode" where we route 50% of throttle candidates to fallback for validation.
Alex: Telemetry needs: per-key & per-family counters (requests, tokens_generated, throttled_count), latency p50/p95 by family, histograms of burst utilization. Store sample payloads for evaluation (opt-out).
Riley: Add a rate-limiter debug endpoint for SEs to replay a request and see which rule fired (auth-gated). Useful for support.
Sam: Implementation note: runtime has routing hooks. Add enforcement layer that consumes policy objects and emits decision events with decision_reason and fallback_model. Emit events to kinesis/topic for downstream analytics.
Maria: UX idea: quota page shows "soft mode" vs "hard mode" per family, plus estimated monthly spend delta if they lower burst caps. PMs will love the $ number.
Alex: Edge cases: multi-model calls (tooling + chat) — charge against the largest family touched. Need deterministic accounting for mixed-model flows.
Riley: Action items:
- Sam: prototype enforcement + headers (ETA 2w)
- Alex: formalize policy schema + runtime hooks PR (ETA 3d)
- Maria: mockups for telemetry & soft-mode toggle (ETA 1w)
- Sam & Riley: spike on cached-token accounting (ETA 4d)
- narwhal-bot: create ticket and add to eng-platform backlog
narwhal-bot: Created ticket PLAT-1748: "Model-family quota + soft-fallbacks" and linked to this thread. :robot_face:
Alex: Thanks — we'll review in tomorrow standup. If anyone has strong opinions on header vs body, ping me.
